interface.shortDescription: Daily briefings and vault workflows for Obsidian.
interface.longDescription: AI-OS Lite packages nine share-safe workflows for Morning Brief preparation and processing, optional evening reflection, project sync, vault commits, deterministic vault audits, and ontology-linted note writing. Each user's vault AGENTS.md remains the source of truth for structure, taxonomy, privacy, and project identity.
